maria-partners: Quick thread: preparing resubmission to AWS/GCP/Azure marketplaces. Need to check: SKU mapping, KMS/BYOK handshake, telemetry gating, and publisher console validation steps. Who can take which item?

nate-cloud: I can own the cloud console validation. For AWS we need AMI visibility to the publisher account and a proper launch permission. Also confirm KMS ARN exchange for BYOK.

sam-legal: I'll review the addition to the DPA and add a short clause for key revocation and proof of deletion for customer keys. Also check marketplace marketing terms.

elaine-ops: Ops will do the KMS integration test and a smoke test for image restore from marketplace. Proposed retention: artifacts kept 120d active, archived after. Will prepare lifecycle examples for S3/GCS/Blob.

zoe-support: Support request: please include a short troubleshooting section for key policy failures and entitlement mismatches. I'll add common error codes and next steps.

maria-partners: Great. Timeline: cloud validation 3 days, legal 4 days, ops runbook 5 days, support doc 3 days. I'll coordinate a resubmission window with marketplaces after sign-off.

listing-bot: task-created: marketplace-resubmit-checklist by maria-partners at 1769666720

nate-cloud: Also flag: GCP sometimes requires image family naming conventions; will include exact names to avoid rejection.

sam-legal: Noted export-control check for included crypto packages.

elaine-ops: I'll share a small `lifecycle.json` snippet and a KMS preflight script in the shared drive.

maria-partners: Perfect. I'll compile the checklist and post back. End thread: thanks everyone :rocket:
